driver: A new unit's contribution to a register builds up over several annual rounds after the unit is created toward the level settled units hold, so a forecast that keeps each existing unit at its present count and adds the units still to come at the settled units' yield, or at the yield the newest units show today, misses both the recent units still building up and the units that will still be young at the horizon, while a uniform completeness factor moves nothing.
driver_concrete: Each new dwelling's electors join the register over the canvasses after it comes into use, toward the settled stock's electors per dwelling by type; the 2032 forecast ages every dwelling in use since 2019 and every dwelling the trajectory places before the 2032 register to its number of canvasses on 1 December 2032.
stump: The default path keeps each dwelling on the 1 December 2025 register at its 2025 count and adds the dwellings since and the trajectory's at the settled stock's electors per dwelling by type, filing Ebborby, Kettermere, Lorrimere North and Tibberfield; the estates completed from 2024 in Lorrimere West, Caldenstow Park and Quenbrook are still joining the register and the North Lorrimere and Tibberfield sites completing from 2030 will still be young in 2032, so aged to their canvasses five wards fail: Lorrimere West, Caldenstow Park, Quenbrook, Ebborby and Kettermere.

differentiation.task235: task235 judges an item lost only once its device has had its next chance to send, read from a real-time contact log; here nothing is lost or waiting to be sent: every dwelling is on the address register and its electors join the register over the canvasses after completion, so the forecast ages each dwelling, built or still to be built, to its canvass count at the horizon.
differentiation.task445: task445 completes holders whose reports have not arrived from each holder's last report and a class drift; here every register has been published and nothing is unreported: a dwelling's electors build up over canvasses toward a settled level, and the step ages dwellings that do not yet exist to their canvass count at the horizon.
differentiation.task481: task481 restates a count onto a new classification by conversion rates whose short window over-represents one kind of record; here no classification changes: a dwelling's electors build up over the canvasses after it is completed, and the forecast ages each dwelling to the 2032 canvass.
